name: contract-first-prep
description: Prepare a greenfield codebase for fast, parallel, multi-agent implementation by writing an immutable contract FIRST. Probes the stack, scaffolds with a strict typecheck gate, writes the single-source-of-truth type/interface contract (incl. a wiring 'context' interface + event contract), a pure-data config file, and shared helpers, then decomposes the system into non-overlapping module file-groups with one named integrator and per-module specs — stopping at a verified blueprint a Workflow or parallel agents can build. Stack-agnostic (TypeScript/Python/Rust/Go/Java variants); ships a check_plan.py validator that proves the decomposition is disjoint and total.
